notes: MAPPING CAVEAT — flag for a human. So 4317722 is the only live official title the marketed programme can sit under, but IE itself never states this. www.ie.edu redirect-loops for WebFetch; pages read directly via curl -L (HTTP 200).

institution: Universidad Nacional de Educación a Distancia (UNED)
programme_name: Máster Universitario en Ingeniería y Ciencia de Datos
official_status: máster universitario (official) — RUCT 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA)'; verificación 11/04/2019, BOE 03/08/2019 and 19/12/2020. UNED's own programme page prints the código RUCT itself
ects: 60 (RUCT: 40 obligatorios + 8 optativos + 12 TFM; UNED page also states 60 ECTS)
modality: a distancia (online) — UNED programme page states modalidad 'A distancia'; UNED is Spain's distance university
language_of_instruction: Castellano — UNED programme page states instruction is in Spanish, with English used for bibliography and for seminars given by international experts; recommended English level B1 (MCER). NOT English-taught.
tuition_total_eur: EUR 1,884.00 for the full 60 ECTS at first-enrolment rates. Arithmetic: 31.40 EUR/ECTS x 60 ECTS = 1,884.00. Repeat enrolments cost more (2nd 50.70, 3rd 55.38, 4th+ 58.50 EUR/ECTS). Add administrative fees: gastos de secretaría 15.15 EUR and apertura de expediente académico 30.30 EUR, plus seguro escolar where applicable
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 — Orden CNU/573/2026, de 8 de junio, precios públicos UNED curso 2026-2027 (Anexo II.2, rama Ingeniería y Arquitectura, 'MÁSTER UNIVERSITARIO EN INGENIERÍA Y CIENCIA DE DATOS'). 2027-28 order not yet published as of 2026-08-25
non_eu_surcharge: NO — explicitly ruled out. The 2026-27 price order states verbatim, clause Segundo.6: 'Los precios públicos aplicables serán los mismos independientemente de la nacionalidad o el país de residencia de los estudiantes.' UNED is a state-wide university whose prices are set by ministerial order, not by an autonomous community's decreto
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT — 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' = 0, i.e. the title carries no compulsory bridging credits). For the applicant, UNED's own programme page specifies no complementos de formación either: access is for holders of a Título de Licenciado/Ingeniero/Graduado en Informática, with related degrees (Telecomunicación, Industrial, Ingeniería Técnica Informática, Física, Matemáticas) and professional IT experience also admitted; 75 places, selected on affinity of background (4 pts), grade average (4 pts) and other merits (2 pts)
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT YET PUBLISHED as of 2026-08-25. Published 2026-27 calendar (record as 2026-27, do not shift forward): admisión for new students 17 May – 10 July 2026 (some masters close 2 June 2026; Ingeniería Industrial runs to 31 July 2026); matrícula 1 July – 21 October 2026, with a second enrolment window 1 February – 10 March 2027 for masters that open one
notes: RUCT code 4316950 confirmed twice: printed on UNED's own programme page and matching the register entry by exact title and university — no reliance on a fuzzy matcher. IMPORTANT for a non-EU applicant: UNED's admission page states that holders of a foreign degree from outside the EHEA without a Spanish equivalencia must obtain an 'Autorización del Rector'; the page as served on 2026-08-25 prints that window as '10 de marzo … 28 de mayo de 2025', which looks like un-updated content — a human should confirm the current-year dates for this step, because it is an extra, earlier gate than the ordinary admission window. The 2026-27 admission window for new students (closing 10 July 2026) has already passed at the time of checking.

institution: Universidad de Navarra — Facultad de Ciencias
programme_name: Máster Universitario en Ciencia de Datos para Ciencias Experimentales
official_status: máster universitario (official) — RUCT 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA POR ACREDITACIÓN INSTITUCIONAL)', Máster RD 822/2021, MECES 3; verificación 10/09/2024, BOE 10/12/2024 and 06/02/2025. UNAV's own programme header carries the badge 'Título Oficial'
ects: 60 — UNAV header: '60 Créditos'; RUCT: 22 obligatorios + 12 optativos + 26 TFM = 60. Duration 12 months
modality: presencial — UNAV header states verbatim 'Presencial / Full time', campus Pamplona, 20 plazas
language_of_instruction: Español — UNAV programme page header states verbatim 'Español'. Admission additionally requires accredited Spanish at B2 (MCER) or an equivalent, or passing an exam at UNAV's Instituto de Idiomas. NOT English-taught, and the Spanish requirement is a hard gate.
tuition_total_eur: EUR 16,000.80 for the full 60 ECTS ('Máster Universitario en Ciencia de datos para ciencias experimentales | 60 | 16.000,80 €', matrícula ordinaria). Separately: application/processing fee EUR 100 and a pre-enrolment reserve of EUR 3,000 (refundable only if the applicant fails to complete their bachelor degree); the reserve is normally deducted from the fee but UNAV does not say so on the admission page
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 — the table is headed verbatim 'Precios correspondientes al curso académico 2026-2027'. 2027-28 prices not yet published as of 2026-08-25
non_eu_surcharge: NOT FOUND — UNAV is a private university publishing a single 'Matrícula ordinaria' figure per master; the price page contains no mention of nationality, residency, extranjeros, or an international rate. Per the brief's rule, silence is NOT FOUND, not 'no'
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT — 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' = 0 for the title). For the applicant, UNAV's admission page does impose an applicant-level condition: candidates must demonstrate basic statistics knowledge (from undergraduate courses or certifiable extracurricular courses), and those lacking it take a 'Curso Cero: Introducción a R y repaso de estadística' worth 1 ECTS. That is the only bridging requirement published, and it is 1 ECTS, not a complementos block. The recommended access profile is STEM graduates including Ingeniería, so a software-engineering degree fits the stated profile
application_window_2027: Rolling, no fixed close date: UNAV states verbatim 'El proceso de admisión al Máster está abierto desde el 1 de octubre al 1 de septiembre de cada año', and adds that it stays open until the 20 places are filled. So for a September 2027 start the window runs 1 October 2026 – 1 September 2027 on the published rule; UNAV publishes no separate 2027-28 calendar and none is needed. No separate earlier non-EU round is published
notes: RUCT code confirmed by exact title-and-university match in the register; UNAV does not print a código RUCT on the programme page. Note the register lists 26 of the 60 ECTS as TFM, which is unusually thesis-heavy — worth knowing before applying. Do not confuse this title with UNAV's two other data masters, which are separate RUCT titles with different prices: Big Data Science (4317139, 19.600,20 €) and Análisis de Datos en Ingeniería at Tecnun (4318517, 18.475,20 €).

institution: Universidad CEU San Pablo — Facultad de Ciencias Económicas y Empresariales
programme_name: Máster Universitario en Análisis y Divulgación de Datos
official_status: máster universitario (official) — RUCT 'Publicado en B.O.E.'; verificación 13/03/2023, BOE 27/07/2023 and 30/01/2024. CEU's own page labels it 'Denominación Oficial: Máster Universitario en Análisis y Divulgación de Datos' and states 'Título verificado favorablemente por la Fundación Madri+d'
ects: 60 — CEU page header: 'Créditos 60 ECTS'. RUCT: 36 obligatorios + 8 optativos + 6 prácticas + 10 TFM = 60. PLUS a compulsory 6-ECTS complemento formativo on top (see complementary_credits_required)
modality: presencial — CEU header states verbatim 'Modalidad Presencial'; taught Fridays 16:00-21:00 and Saturdays 09:00-15:00 at the Facultad de Ciencias Económicas y Empresariales, Madrid; 20 plazas
language_of_instruction: Español — CEU programme page header states verbatim 'Idioma Español'. NOT English-taught
tuition_total_eur: EUR 8,000.00 total ('Precio total 8.000,00 €'), with a 'Cuota de reserva 1.600,00 €' that is deducted from the total ('Se descontará del precio total')
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 — the price block is headed verbatim 'Precio Curso 26-27'. 2027-28 prices not published as of 2026-08-25
non_eu_surcharge: NOT FOUND — CEU is private and publishes one 'Precio total' with no nationality- or residency-based variation anywhere on the programme or admission pages. Silence, so recorded as NOT FOUND rather than 'no'
complementary_credits_required: 6 ECTS, COMPULSORY, from the study plan of the title itself — not from RUCT. The RUCT detail page does not publish the 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' row for this title (NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT). CEU's own plan de estudios lists a 'Complementos Formativos' block stating verbatim: 'El alumno cursará una de las dos opciones, "Estadística" o "Comunicación", dependiendo de sus conocimientos y experiencia previos' — 'Complemento Formativo en Estadística 6 ECTS' or 'Complemento Formativo en Comunicación 6 ECTS', both carrying the carácter 'Complementos de Formación'. An engineering graduate would be routed to the Comunicación complemento. So the effective load is 66 ECTS, not 60. Applicant-level rule (from CEU's criterios de admisión): 'El perfil de ingreso recomendado ... es ser Licenciado o Graduado preferentemente en titulaciones relacionadas, bien con la comunicación, bien con el análisis de datos', and applicants must demonstrate prior knowledge in one of the two strands (estadística aplicada or comunicación)
application_window_2027: NOT FOUND — CEU publishes no dated admission window for másteres universitarios on either the programme page or https://www.uspceu.com/admision-ayuda/admision-posgrado. The published process is a rolling sequence with no deadlines: (1) documentación — DNI, carta de motivación y certificado de estudios; (2) entrevista de admisión with the master's director; (3) reserva de plaza (1.600 €, deducted from the total); (4) matrícula at the campus secretaría. The programme page shows 'Inicio Septiembre 2026' for the current cycle, and CEU's information-request form offers start years 2026/27, 2027/28 and 2028/29, so a 2027 entry is contemplated but undated
notes: RUCT code confirmed by exact title-and-university match ('… por la Universidad San Pablo-CEU'); CEU does not print a código RUCT on the page. NOTE FOR THE CANDIDATE PROFILE: this is the one programme in this slice with a genuine, published, compulsory complementos block — 6 extra ECTS — and it is invisible in RUCT, which publishes no complementos row for the title. It also sits in the Facultad de Ciencias Económicas, is taught Friday evening / Saturday morning, and is a data-journalism / divulgación programme rather than a technical data-science one.
